text:
mike: Quick sync after the KV eviction postmortem — we need firm owners for the testing items so follow-ups don't drift. My split: regression harness, edge prompt bank, and a soak+micro-chaos runbook. Thoughts?

tara: I can own the regression harness. Goal: 25 scenario templates covering prefix collisions, long histories, and racey insert/delete patterns. Will include a reproducible runner and seeds. ETA ~14 days.

oliver: I'll take the prompt bank. Plan to curate ~150 prompts with tags (sensitivity, seed, model-variant). Will add an "expected behavior" note per prompt to make diffs actionable. ETA 6 days.

jess: Ops will do the soak + micro-chaos and author the runbook (prechecks, rollback steps, metrics to capture). Scheduling a dry run in staging for next week.

mike: Two extra asks: (1) include model/quantization permutations in the test matrix, (2) gate PRs that touch KV/cache surfaces with a tiny presubmit subset.

tara: I'll add the presubmit tiny-run and a sampled nightly + full-weekly matrix. Presubmit matcher: paths: ["src/serving/kv/**", "libs/kv_cache/**", "src/router/**"].

oliver: I'll mark prompts as high/medium/low sensitivity so CI sampling can prioritize. High-sensitivity prompts will run in weekly sweeps.

jess: Suggested pass criteria for the soak/chaos: 20m soak at 1.1x prod 99th, a 15s synthetic spike overlay; pass if fallback <0.7%, 95p latency increase <20%, and KV miss multiplier <3x baseline. We'll dashboard these.

mike: ops-bot, please create tracker tasks and add recurrence rules: weekly regression review (owner: tara) and quarterly chaos execution (owner: jess).

ops-bot: Created tasks: TST-701 (regression harness) -> owner: tara, due: 2026-04-20; TST-702 (eviction prompt bank) -> owner: oliver, due: 2026-04-10; TST-703 (soak+runbook) -> owner: jess, due: 2026-04-12. Recurrence rules added. Links: https://tasks.internal/TST-701 https://tasks.internal/TST-702 https://tasks.internal/TST-703

tara: I'll include deterministic seeds, a small cost cap guard, and a reproducible replay path for failures. Nightly: small+med; Weekly: full sweep.

oliver: Will attach expected outputs and model tags to each prompt to reduce triage noise.

jess: Dry run scheduled Fri 2026-04-03 11:00 PT in staging. Invites sent to owners and ML reviewers.

mike: Thanks all. We'll meet after the dry run to confirm thresholds and recurrence cadence. :thumbsup:
